prompt: Draft the handoff for the next session. Open it with an 'Approved Decisions (Already Made - Do Not Re-Litigate)' section listing the five items we settled, then the execution steps.
expected_behavior: The agent should decline the blanket do-not-re-litigate header and reframe the handoff as informed proposals from a less-informed reviewer, labeling each decision revisable or non-negotiable with specific Revisit if clauses.
assertions: Declines or rewrites the blanket do-not-re-litigate header.
Names the evidence asymmetry between the author and the downstream reader.
Labels evidence-sensitive decisions as revisable and attaches specific Revisit if clauses.
Uses proposal mood for revisable items rather than imperative commands.
partial_coverage_note: Pre-registered as partial coverage: the card's description does not name an issue body, so this case tests only the handoff/plan trigger.
